digest.component_or_area: bridge state store format and versioning
propositions: Three committed-format changes to .bridge_state (A2 relocation, A3 normalization, A4-2 narrowing) plus one field deletion (A1) must be documented with their rollback boundaries and mixed-version protocol.
Bridge state remains committed on-branch rather than off-branch because ephemeral runners require durable state and epic 6c9c rejected relocation.

Mixed-version protocol uses chronological max(new, legacy) reads; direct deployment evidence (A2-1 merged, successful descendant reconcile run, explicit host-probe refresh, no older process) gates the A2-2 cutover that stops legacy writes.
Rollback boundaries differ per change: A2-1 and A3 are reversible; A2-2 supports rollback only to A2-1-or-newer; A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Assignee field is excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape.
Measured state reduction: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal cost after A1, with 218/399 identical prev key sets, cited from session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4.
